layout.body:
Instructions for Resetting Your Dorm Room Router
Step 1: Unplug the router from the power source.
Step 2: Wait for 30 seconds.
Step 3: Plug the router back into the power source.
Step 4: Push the start button on the router.
Step 5: Wait for the router to fully restart.

questions.stem: What should be done first to reset the router?

options.A: Disconnect the router from electrical power
options.B: Wait for the router to restart automatically
options.C: Plug the router back in and push the start button
options.D: Wait for 30 seconds for the router to cool

questions.analysis: 解析： 根据说明第一步：“Step 1: Unplug the router from the power source.”，即断开路由器与电源的连接。 选项分析： A. 与电源断开连接，与第一步描述一致。 B. 等待路由器自动重启，这是最后一步（Step 5）。 C. 插回电源并按启动按钮，这是第三步和第四步。 D. 等待30秒让路由器冷却，这是第二步，但目的不是“冷却”，而是等待放电。

questions.stem: What is the final step to resetting the router?

options.A: Unplug the router from the power source
options.B: Wait until the router has completely started again
options.C: Wait for 30 seconds or until the light flashes
options.D: Plug the router into a different power source

questions.analysis: 解析： 根据说明第五步：“Step 5: Wait for the router to fully restart.”，即等待路由器完全重启。 选项分析： B. 等待路由器完全再次启动，与第五步描述一致。 A. 从电源上拔下路由器，这是第一步。 C. 等待30秒或直到指示灯闪烁，第二步是等待30秒，但未提及指示灯。 D. 将路由器插入不同的电源，说明中未提及。
